// ============================================================ // LÓGICA DEL PANEL DE RECLUTAMIENTO ADMIN // ============================================================ import { getApiUrl, showCustomAlert } from './src/modules/index.js'; const API_URL = getApiUrl(); // ============================================================ // AUTENTICACIÓN POR COOKIES (igual que admin-panel.js) // ============================================================ // El admin panel usa cookies httpOnly gestionadas por el backend. // No usamos localStorage ni Bearer tokens. // Si la cookie no existe o expiró, el backend responde 401 // y redirigimos a admin.html (login). // Función segura para peticiones autenticadas (igual que apiFetch en admin-panel.js) async function apiFetch(endpoint) { const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}${endpoint}`, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include' // Envía las cookies httpOnly automáticamente }); // Si no está autenticado, redirigir al login if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) { window.location.href = 'admin.html'; throw new Error('Sesión expirada.'); } return response.json(); } // Función para peticiones con body (PATCH, POST) async function apiFetchWithBody(endpoint, method, body) { const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}${endpoint}`, { method: method, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include', // Cookies httpOnly body: JSON.stringify(body) }); if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) { window.location.href = 'admin.html'; throw new Error('Sesión expirada.'); } return response.json(); } // Elementos del DOM const tableBody = document.getElementById('talentTableBody'); const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput'); const statusFilter = document.getElementById('statusFilter'); const roleFilter = document.getElementById('roleFilter'); // Cargar postulaciones async function loadProposals() { try { const params = new URLSearchParams(); const status = statusFilter.value; const role = roleFilter.value; const search = searchInput.value.trim(); if (status !== 'all') params.set('status', status); if (role !== 'all') params.set('role', role); if (search) params.set('search', search); const data = await apiFetch(`/api/recruitment/admin/list?${params.toString()}`); if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.message); renderTable(data.proposals); updateStats(data.proposals); } catch (error) { tableBody.innerHTML = `
⚠️

Error al cargar: ${error.message}

`; } } // Renderizar tabla con toda la información function renderTable(proposals) { if (proposals.length === 0) { tableBody.innerHTML = `
📭

No hay postulaciones con estos filtros.

`; return; } tableBody.innerHTML = proposals.map(p => { const date = new Date(p.created_at).toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }); // Helpers de sanitización de links para prevenir XSS const safeCvUrl = (p.cv_url && (p.cv_url.startsWith('http://') || p.cv_url.startsWith('https://'))) ? p.cv_url : null; const safeLinkedinUrl = (p.linkedin_url && (p.linkedin_url.startsWith('http://') || p.linkedin_url.startsWith('https://'))) ? p.linkedin_url : null; const safePortfolioUrl = (p.portfolio_url && (p.portfolio_url.startsWith('http://') || p.portfolio_url.startsWith('https://'))) ? p.portfolio_url : null; const safeGithubUrl = (p.github_url && (p.github_url.startsWith('http://') || p.github_url.startsWith('https://'))) ? p.github_url : null; return `
${escapeHtml(p.full_name.charAt(0))}
${escapeHtml(p.full_name)} ID: #${p.id} ${p.years_experience ? `· ${escapeHtml(p.years_experience)}` : ''}
${escapeHtml(p.email)}
${safeCvUrl ? ` Ver CV ↗` : ''} ${safeLinkedinUrl ? ` LinkedIn ↗` : ''} ${safePortfolioUrl ? ` Portfolio ↗` : ''} ${safeGithubUrl ? ` GitHub ↗` : ''}
${escapeHtml(p.role)} ${p.expected_salary ? `$ ${escapeHtml(p.expected_salary)}` : 'N/A'} ${date} ${p.status.toUpperCase()}
${['pending', 'reviewing'].includes(p.status) ? ` ` : ''}
`; }).join(''); } // Mapa en memoria para acceso ultrarrápido a postulaciones cargadas let currentProposalsMap = new Map(); let activeCandidateId = null; // Sobrescribir renderTable para guardar mapeo en memoria const originalRenderTable = renderTable; // Actualizar estadísticas de forma eficiente function updateStats(proposals) { currentProposalsMap.clear(); proposals.forEach(p => currentProposalsMap.set(p.id, p)); const total = proposals.length; const pending = proposals.filter(p => p.status === 'pending').length; const reviewing = proposals.filter(p => p.status === 'reviewing').length; document.getElementById('statTotal').textContent = total; document.getElementById('statPending').textContent = pending; document.getElementById('statReviewing').textContent = reviewing; } // Abrir Modal ATS de Evaluación de Candidato function openCandidateModal(id) { const p = currentProposalsMap.get(id); if (!p) return; activeCandidateId = id; const modal = document.getElementById('candidateDetailModal'); if (!modal) return; document.getElementById('modalAvatar').textContent = p.full_name.charAt(0).toUpperCase(); document.getElementById('modalFullName').textContent = p.full_name; const badgeEl = document.getElementById('modalStatusBadge'); badgeEl.className = `status-btn ${p.status}`; badgeEl.textContent = p.status.toUpperCase(); document.getElementById('modalRole').textContent = p.role; document.getElementById('modalYearsExperience').textContent = p.years_experience || 'Experiencia no especificada'; document.getElementById('modalEmail').textContent = p.email; document.getElementById('modalSalary').textContent = p.expected_salary ? `$ ${p.expected_salary} USD / mes` : 'No especificado'; const date = new Date(p.created_at).toLocaleDateString('es-ES', { day: '2-digit', month: 'long', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }); document.getElementById('modalDate').textContent = date; // Renderizar Botones Destacados de Enlaces const linksContainer = document.getElementById('modalLinksContainer'); linksContainer.innerHTML = ''; const safeCvUrl = (p.cv_url && /^https?:\/\//i.test(p.cv_url)) ? p.cv_url : null; const safeLinkedinUrl = (p.linkedin_url && /^https?:\/\//i.test(p.linkedin_url)) ? p.linkedin_url : null; const safePortfolioUrl = (p.portfolio_url && /^https?:\/\//i.test(p.portfolio_url)) ? p.portfolio_url : null; const safeGithubUrl = (p.github_url && /^https?:\/\//i.test(p.github_url)) ? p.github_url : null; if (safeCvUrl) { linksContainer.innerHTML += ` Abrir CV en la Nube ↗ `; } if (safeLinkedinUrl) { linksContainer.innerHTML += ` Perfil LinkedIn ↗ `; } if (safePortfolioUrl) { linksContainer.innerHTML += ` Portfolio / Sitio Web ↗ `; } if (safeGithubUrl) { linksContainer.innerHTML += ` Repositorio GitHub ↗ `; } if (!safeCvUrl && !safeLinkedinUrl && !safePortfolioUrl && !safeGithubUrl) { linksContainer.innerHTML = 'No se proporcionaron enlaces adicionales.'; } // Carta de Presentación document.getElementById('modalCoverLetter').textContent = p.cover_letter || 'Sin carta de presentación.'; document.getElementById('modalReviewerNotes').value = p.reviewer_notes || ''; modal.style.display = 'flex'; } function closeCandidateModal() { const modal = document.getElementById('candidateDetailModal'); if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none'; activeCandidateId = null; } async function changeStatusFromModal(newStatus) { if (!activeCandidateId) return; const notes = document.getElementById('modalReviewerNotes')?.value?.trim() || null; try { const data = await apiFetchWithBody(`/api/recruitment/admin/${activeCandidateId}/status`, 'PATCH', { status: newStatus, notes }); if (data.success) { closeCandidateModal(); loadProposals(); } else { showCustomAlert('Error: ' + data.message); } } catch (error) { showCustomAlert('Error al actualizar estado: ' + error.message); } } async function saveCandidateNotes() { if (!activeCandidateId) return; const p = currentProposalsMap.get(activeCandidateId); if (!p) return; const notes = document.getElementById('modalReviewerNotes')?.value?.trim() || ''; try { const data = await apiFetchWithBody(`/api/recruitment/admin/${activeCandidateId}/status`, 'PATCH', { status: p.status, notes }); if (data.success) { showCustomAlert('✅ Observaciones guardadas con éxito.'); loadProposals(); } else { showCustomAlert('Error: ' + data.message); } } catch (error) { showCustomAlert('Error al guardar notas: ' + error.message); } } // Actualizar estado de una postulación desde botón de tabla async function updateStatus(id, newStatus) { const notes = newStatus === 'rejected' ? prompt('¿Motivo del rechazo? (opcional):') : null; try { const data = await apiFetchWithBody(`/api/recruitment/admin/${id}/status`, 'PATCH', { status: newStatus, notes }); if (data.success) { loadProposals(); } else { showCustomAlert('Error: ' + data.message); } } catch (error) { showCustomAlert('Error de conexión: ' + error.message); } } // Registrar en window window.openCandidateModal = openCandidateModal; window.closeCandidateModal = closeCandidateModal; window.changeStatusFromModal = changeStatusFromModal; window.saveCandidateNotes = saveCandidateNotes; window.updateStatus = updateStatus; // Sanitización XSS function escapeHtml(text) { if (!text) return ''; const div = document.createElement('div'); div.textContent = text; return div.innerHTML; } function escapeAttr(text) { if (!text) return ''; return text.replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, '''); } searchInput.addEventListener('input', debounce(loadProposals, 400)); statusFilter.addEventListener('change', loadProposals); roleFilter.addEventListener('change', loadProposals); function debounce(fn, ms) { let timer; return function(...args) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(() => fn.apply(this, args), ms); }; } loadProposals();
